data_objects.name: filtered_sparse_feature_vectors
data_objects.meaning: Record identifiers paired with filtered comma-separated sparse numeric key:value feature vectors.

data_objects.name: filtered_feature_mapping
data_objects.meaning: Lookup from retained Column_N feature names to opaque source-detail codes.

variables.name: filtered_kv_feature_str
variables.meaning: Filtered sparse feature vector serialized as comma-separated integer_key:numeric_value pairs.

variables.name: feature_name
variables.meaning: Retained feature name formatted as Column_N; N corresponds to an integer key in filtered_kv_feature_str.

variables.name: detail
variables.meaning: Opaque source feature code associated one-to-one with feature_name, such as SC_C... or var....

structure.description: The integer key N in input_1.csv links to input_2.csv through feature_name = Column_N. The retained key set and mapping table cover the same feature-name set.

uncertainties: The meanings, units, selection criteria, and scaling of retained features are not documented.
annotation_notes: An absent key in a sparse row is different from a present key with value zero.
Parse filtered_kv_feature_str on commas and then split each pair at its first colon.
